title: US single release: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da | 1976
content:
The Beatles’ 1968 song ‘Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da’ was released as a single in the USA on 8 November 1976.

It was issued in a white sleeve with a serial number, just as copies of the White Album had been. Another 1968 Beatles song, ‘Julia’, was on the b-side.

‘Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da’ peaked at number 49 on the Billboard Hot 100, and 47 on the Cash Box Top 100.
